result.title: Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control
result.summary: Diffusion models can learn multimodal distributions over finite-horizon state-input sequences, providing a way to generate candidates for predictive control. However, sequences generated by a pretrained model may violate safety constraints introduced at deployment, for example when obstacles are added or repositioned. Retraining whenever these constraints change limits the usefulness of learned predictive controllers. In this paper, we propose Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control (TCA-DPC), an algorithm for adapting the sampling distribution of a pretrained diffusion controller to newly introduced safety constraints without retraining. We treat the pretrained model as a prior over finite-horizon sequences and define an adapted distribution through exponential tilting based on a constraint-violation penalty. The tilt strength is adjusted online using the fraction of generated sequences that fail constraint verification. We approximately sample the adapted distribution using the Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm in the Gaussian noise space of the pretrained diffusion sampler.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TCA-DPC：将预训练扩散预测控制器视为有限时域状态-输入序列上的先验，为应对部署时新增的安全约束而不重训，用基于约束违反惩罚的指数倾斜改造采样分布，并按生成序列未通过约束校验的比例在线调节倾斜强度，再在高斯噪声空间用 MALA 近似采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与视觉/多模态推理无直接关系，但其「按验证失败率在线调整扩散采样分布并在噪声空间做 MCMC」的测试时机制，可供核查是否能借鉴为 LVR 中 latent 采样与验证反馈耦合、以及采样预算分配的线索。
